text: Slabchisel's Survey is a new dwarven camp established near the abandoned Gnoll camps close to Dun Algaz in the Wetlands.

The Slave Pits is a Southsea mercenary camp found on the northwestern shores of the Lost Isles. It's here that the recaptured goblins, class trainers included, have been taken. The goblin Candy Cane is overseeing the area in Trade Prince Gallywixs name.
__NOTOC__ Slamp Wobblecog is a gnomish member of Gnomeregan Covert Ops located in Frostmane Retreat in Dun Morogh.

This item looks very much like the bleached jaw section of a tauren skeleton. Although they appear to large to fit, the jaws can be easily slipped into the mouth of any creature, where they snap into place like a set of dentures. The wearer's jaw now protrudes downward, with saliva-coated teeth extending out in several directions, giving the wearer a truly horrifying appearance.
Slap Rock is sold by Vinny Slapchop after the dragon has appeared on Kezan.
Slayer of Stupid, Incompetent, and Disappointing Minions is a title granted by Nefarian upon killing Maloriak on heroic mode. The title is not permanent, but is granted via a 30-minute buff called :
Slate Quicksand is an earthen quest giver found at the Quaking Fields in Deepholm.

The Slain Watchman's body is located on the outskirts of Duskhaven in Gilneas. This unfortunate soul had the misfortune of holding the watch overlooking the waters off the coast and was undoubtedly murdered by the invading Forsaken vanguard in order to mask their approach until the last second.
Slave Workers are slaves working for the Dark Iron dwarves within the Slag Pit of the Searing Gorge.
Slain Wildkin Feather is a quest item objective of Aroom's Farewell.
__NOTOC__ Slaverjaw is a rare hyena located in Tanaris. It uses the red hyena skin formerly found on the Scarlet Tracking Hound and currently used by Bloodsnarl Hyena.
Slag Furies are lava elementals found in the Stormwind Stockade.
The Slate Dragon is a Stone dragon that has been captured by Twilight's Hammer and is being held in the Bastion of Twilight.
Slad'ran Constrictors are snakes summoned by Slad'ran in the Den of Sseratus in Gundrak.
Sleeping Guardians are quilen located at the Pools of Youth in Krasarang Wilds.
Slateskin Troublemakers were level 90 sprites that could be found at Mistfall Village in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Sleazy is a gnome located in Brawl'gar Arena and Bizmo's Brawlpub as part of the Leper Gnome Quintet encounter.
Slavermaw is a rare elite devilsaur that can be found in the hills to the west of Dustfire Valley in the Searing Gorge.
Sleepy Hozen Brawlers are hozen found in the Mama's Pantry in the Stormstout Brewery who sleeps. They act aggressively to those who wakes them up and dies instantly from Habanero Brews explosions.
Slaver's Plate is a quest reward from Speaking with Nezzliok.
The Sleep Dust can be purchased from Supplier Bao in the Bleak Hollow on the Isle of Thunder (or in the Troves of the Thunder King single-player scenario) in exchange for .
Slavemaster Shiaxu is the final boss of To the Skies! (quest) He is found at the southern end of the Lightning Vein Mine.
__NOTOC__ Slavemaster Turgall is an ogre located in Turgall's Den in Frostfire Ridge.
Slag Elementals are slag elementals summoned by Slavemaster Turgall found in Turgall's Den in Frostfire Ridge.
The Sleepy Rangari is a draenei located in the Dyvari Overgrowth in .
Slave Watcher Crushto is one of the first two bosses in Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
__NOTOC__ Slave Hunter Krag is an ogre located in Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.
__NOTOC__ Slave Hunter Brol is an ogre located at Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.
__NOTOC__ Slave Hunter Mol is an ogre located at Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.
Slavemaster Ok'mok is an ogre located in Stonemaul Arena in Gorgrond.
Sleeper's Lair is a cavern under the Frostwind Crag in Frostfire Ridge. The pale orcs are in this cave awakening Shui Halad.
Slag Behemoth is a magma giant located at the Blast Furnace in Blackrock Foundry.

The Slagmill Press is a large conveyor belt system with large stampers in the Blackrock Foundry. Operations are overseen by Hans'gar and Franzok. Defeating them opens up the gateways to the Burning Font.
Sleepy Dockhand may refer to: *Sleepy Dockhand (Frostwall) *Sleepy Dockhand (Lunarfall)
Slavebreaker Chestguard is a quest reward from A Potential Ally.
Slavebreaker Chainmail is a quest reward from A Potential Ally.
Skytooth is a wolf located in . It was killed by Worgskin the Savage.
Sledge is a mo'arg brute found at the Ward of the Betrayer in Vault of the Wardens.
Slarkhide has a chance to be looted from Big Crate of Salvage.
Skysinger Gloves is a quest reward from Declawing The Bloodmane.
Slayer of Sin'dorei is a title awarded upon completing the Garrison achievement Nemesis: Slayer of Sin'dorei. The title appears after your character's name: :, Slayer of Sin'dorei
__NOTOC__ Skystone can be found when Prospecting Felslate and Leystone Ore.

Slaghammer's Notes: The New Leader is one of three books authored by Shadowlord Slaghammer found at the Twilight's Hammer camp in the Whispering Forest in the Tirisfal Glades. It needs to be inspected for the first stage of Blade in Twilight.

Slaghammer's Notes: Tyr's Fall is one of three books authored by Shadowlord Slaghammer found at the Twilight's Hammer camp in the Whispering Forest in the Tirisfal Glades. It needs to be inspected for the first stage of Blade in Twilight.

Slaghammer's Notes: Xal'atath, the Blade of the Black Empire is one of three books authored by Shadowlord Slaghammer found at the Twilight's Hammer camp in the Whispering Forest in the Tirisfal Glades. It needs to be inspected for the first stage of Blade in Twilight.
Sleeping Hollow is a small cave on the Cove of Nashal in northwestern Stormheim. A few sleeping bears can be found in here.
Slayin' to Seven was an achievement earned by reaching Honor Prestige Level 7.
Slavehunter Zsanesh is a naga located in the Shipwreck Arena in Azsuna. He can be found guarding a small treasure chest containing Sternfathom's Pet Journal.
Sleepy Dhow is a sea giant found at Shipwreck Arena in Azsuna. He is guarding Giants' Stash of Weapons.

Skystormer is a large dark blue-light green hippogryph who dwells in southwestern Feralas, west of the Ruins of Isildien. She will only appear after hunters who know the secrets of taming feathermanes spook a certain amount of hippogryphs of the same color by /patting them.
The Slayer's Felbroken Shrieker is the demon hunter class hall mount.
Slave Traps are traps located at the Scavenger's Boneyard in the Antoran Wastes.
Slavemaster Anthiss is a naga of the Hatecoil taken out by the class orders.
Slavering Devourers are ur'zul located in Krokuun and the Arcatraz during Foiling the Legion's Jailbreak.
Skysinger Brew can be looted from Bubbling Keg on the Wandering Isle.
Slaughterhouse Protectors are abominations found in the Eastern Plaguelands.
The Slain Cannoneer is a dead orc lying in the Storm's Fury Wreckage in Deepholm.
Skyshredder Turrets are cannons located aboard The Skyshredder in the Twilight Highlands.

Slaughtered Dragonmaw Warriors are deceased Dragonmaw orcs located northwest of Ruins of Drakgor in Twilight Highlands. The bodies are surrounded by Bound Fleshburners and a few Twilight Bonebreakers.
Slaughtered Drakkari are ice trolls located in Zeb'Halak in Grizzly Hills.
Slagmaul is a magma giant located at the Molten Fields in the Firelands.
Slaughtered Footmen are deceased humans located in Theramore's Fall.
The Slaughtered Officer is a deceased human located in Theramore's Fall.
Slain Scarlet Friars are deceased humans located at the Scarlet Encampment and the Crusader Outpost in Tirisfal Glades, apparently killed by Lilian Voss.
Slain Scarlet Zealots are deceased humans located at the Scarlet Encampment and the Crusader Outpost in Tirisfal Glades, apparently killed by Lilian Voss.
Sleek Quills drop from the following porcupines in Kul Tiras: *Quillrat Matriarch *Guarded Quillrat *Invasive Quillrat
Slavering Dreadwing are felbats located on the Broken Shore.

Slain Trappers are dead human trappers that can be found at multiple locations in the Grizzly Hills. Slain Trappers can be found at the Evergreen Trading Post. This post has been overrun by the Horde of Conquest Hold, presumably killing its original inhabitants. Another group is found at White Pine Trading Post, having been killed by the trapper dissident Sasha. A third group is found around the unnamed post near the Granite Springs. The tower is on fire and all its denizens are dead.
Slab of Cream Cheese is most commonly bought from innkeepers and food vendors in Kul Tiras.

Skystep Potion is a potion created with alchemy (1); its recipe, Recipe: Skystep Potion, is purchasable from Patricia Egan after completing Return the Filter. This item can also be found inside Mana-Tinged Pack and Wyrmtongue Cache of Supplies.
Slayer's Precision is an Assassination rogue artifact trait. It requires all other base traits to be purchased.

The Sleeping Murloc is an item that can be fished up from open water in Suramar and from Runescale Koi Schools, with an increased chance to be caught when using an Arcane Lure. It is also sold by Sha'leth for . When this item is used, it will summon a Confused Seerspine Murloc, who will run around the surrounding area while dropping Runescale Koi and Silver Mackerel, as well as either Seerspine Puffer or Seerspine Puffer depending on whether or not the user has the Underlight Angler. Unlike looting the similar Landlocked Shark, other members of the user's group can retrieve fish dropped by the murloc.
The Slayer's Tabard is a tabard sold by Falara Nightsong aboard the Fel Hammer for .
Slaughtered Vulpera are vulpera corpses located next to a pile of Freshly Dug Sand in the Port of Zem'lan as well as at Taz'raka the Traitor's ruins in Vol'dun.
The Skywatch Adherent Locket is a quest reward from Hardly Working.
The Slatewhisker are a group of kobolds who would be found on the Broken Isles.
Slain Troggs are deceased troggs located in Ragefire Chasm. Their bodies are on fire.
The Skysinger Spaulders is a quest reward from Hidden in Plain Sight.
The Skysinger Wristwraps is a quest reward from The Bloodmane.
Sleeping Cricket is a grummle located at the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor.
The Skysinger Helm is a quest reward from A Feast of Shadows
The Skywatch Adherent Pendant is a quest reward from Hardly Working.
The Skywatch Adherent Choker is a quest reward from Hardly Working.
The Skywatch Adherant Necklace is a quest reward from Hardly Working.
The Skywatch Adherant Gorget is a quest reward from Hardly Working.
Slaughtered Sentinels are deceased night elves located in Delaryn's Demise in Darkshore.
Skyshredder Crewmembers are goblins located aboard The Skyshredder in the Twilight Highlands.
Slateclaw Whelps are juvenile pterrordax located atop the main peak in Redrock Mesa in Vol'dun. Some of them are next to Ak'tar.
Slateclaw Shriekers are pterrordax located in Redrock Mesa in Vol'dun, mainly atop the mesa's main peak.
__NOTOC__ Skyterror Broodmothers are pterrordax located in Nazmir.
The Slain Stockade Guard is a deceased human located in Stormwind Stockade.
Slain Infantrymen are deceased humans located in on Teller Farm in Drustvar during Faction Assaults.
Slain Grunts are deceased orcs located on Teller Farm in Drustvar during Faction Assaults.
The Slathered Rib is found throughout the Return to Karazhan. This meat is part of the Riddle of Jenafur.
__NOTOC__ Sleepless Voidseekers are void elves located in Deadwind Pass.
Slain Sha'tar Vindicators are dead draenei located in the Bone Wastes south of Auchindoun in Terokkar Forest. Auchenai Doomsayers reanimate their spirits into Unliving Guardians.
Slavemaster's Malevolence is a quest reward from Legion world quests or can be obtained from caches.
Slavemaster Ul'rok is a n'raqi located in the Trade District in the Vision of Stormwind. The slavemaster must be dealt with before the Torment Cells can be opened.
Slaughtered Boars are boars located in the Vision of Orgrimmar.

The Skysong River is a large river that flows through central , forming a natural barrier between the zone's more peaceful southern side and the more dangerous northern side. The river starts out as two separate, parallel streams which flow out of in the northeast and continue past Gurgthock's Stash and Yrel's Watch before joining into a single river just west of Lok-rath. The river then continues west past the Ruins of Na'gwa and Riverside Post before forming a large, swampy delta between Mok'gol Watchpost and the and finally emptying into the South Sea on the southern side of the Cliffs of Highmaul.
Slagnarok is a quest achievement earned by defeating 20 creatures after slagging them with goren acid in Magnarok.
Slabchop is a dredger located in Pridefall Hamlet in Revendreth.

Slain Crew Members are dead Alliance footmen killed by the Twilight's Hammer in the raid on the Llane's Oath in Deepholm. During All Our Friends Are Dead, their spirits are required to be summoned for more information about what happened on the ship.

Slain Crew Member's Spirits are ghosts summoned from the bodies of Slain Crew Members on the Llane's Oath in Deepholm using the Spirit Totem during All Our Friends Are Dead. They sometimes attack the player, thinking that they're a Twilight's Hammer attacker.
Skytone Greatsword is a quest reward from The Hand of Doubt.
Skytone Quickblade is a quest reward from The Hand of Doubt.
Slanknen is a :soulshape located in Ardenweald. They are initially found as a soul in the Spirit Glen. They were an environmental protector in life.
Sleepy Toadstools are pick pocketed from faeries in Ardenweald.
Sleep Slime drops from frogs in Ardenweald and the Mists of Tirna Scithe.
Slain Blighted are Drust located at the Glittering Falls in Ardenweald.
Slavering Skullcleavers are jungle trolls located in the Withering Thicket and Bashal'Aran in Darkshore during In Darkest Night.

Slayer Araya is a gladiator located in the armory in the southeastern part of the Seat of the Primus, where he sells Necrolord Covenant armor and cosmetic weapon appearances that are unlocked by progressing through the :Necrolords Campaign. A Prime Outfitter is always standing by Araya and hammering away at his armor.
Slagshell Hatchlings are maw roaches located in Zovaal's Cauldron in the Maw.
Slain Iron Dwarves are iron dwarves located by the entrance to the Hall of Memories and beyond in Ulduar.
Slain Iron Vrykul are iron vrykul located by the entrance to the Hall of Memories and beyond in Ulduar.
Sleeping Armaments are found inside Mawsworn Caches in Korthia. Each one will summon a singular Mawforged Weapons animated weapon to serve as a guardian for two minutes.
Slaughterhouse-Chain Bracers drop from Raal the Gluttonous in Waycrest Manor.
__NOTOC__ Slain Auchenai Warriors are dead draenei located in the Bone Wastes on the south side of Auchindoun in Terokkar Forest. Auchenai Doomsayers reanimate their spirits into Unliving Initiates.
Slatesteel Gauntlets are looted from Small Iron Metamorphosis Geode.
Skyterror's Stonehide Leggings drop from Echelon in the Halls of Atonement.
Slaughterhouse Spaulders drop from The Butcher in Highmaul and are looted from Cache of Highmaul Treasures.
Slag-Stained Legplates drops from Volkhan in the Halls of Lightning.
Slagshot Slammer is found in Thresher's Wharf in Stormsong Valley.
Skyward Savior's Talon drops from Tahkwitz at the Fissured Breach in Zereth Mortis.
Slaughtered Pigs are dead pigs located in Fletcher's Hollow in Drustvar.
Slain Shado-Pan Defenders are dead pandaren found in the Grove of Fallen Blossoms in the Shado-Pan Monastery.
Slain Shado-pan Initiates are dead pandaren located on the path to the Grove of Falling Blossoms in the Shado-Pan Monastery.
Sleet Shined Armguards are a quest reward from Urgent Action Required in the Azure Span.
Slam Bam Swill is found in a tree in the Crumbling Cliffs in the Waking Shores. The tree servers as the camp for Cynthia Cloudwhisper, Travis Moreau and Ku-Mo.
Skyskin Hornstrider is sold by Brendormi in the Primalist Future for .
Sleep-Deprived Students are dracthyr located in the Late Night Lab in Thaldraszus. They are kept awake by the coffee provided by Bromithus.
Sleeping on the Job is a quest achievement earned by performing /sleep next to the Dreamguards in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
The Slagmire is located north of the Obsidian Citadel in the Waking Shores.
__NOTOC__ Sleepless Fickleshell is a turtle located in Thaldraszus.
Slain Scourge Troopers are skeletons located in the Eastern Plaguelands.
__NOTOC__ Slagshop Workers are orcs located in Blackrock Foundry.
Slain Alliance Soldiers are dead humans located throughout the Broken Front in Icecrown.
Slain Gelikyr Investigators are dragonspawn located in Gelikyr Overlook in Thaldraszus.
Slain Gelikyr Guards are drakonid located in Gelikyr Overlook in Thaldraszus.
Slagnaros is a fire elemental located atop the tallest tower at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus.
Slain Highborne are dead night elves located at the Passage of Time and in Ironormu's Vault in Thaldraszus.
Slain Queen's Guards are dead night elves located at the Passage of Time and in Ironormu's Vault in Thaldraszus.

Skyspeaker's Envelope drops from: *Mikrin of the Raging Winds *Sparkspitter Vrak *Ty'foon the Ascended *Zenet Avis *Prozela Galeshot *Tempestrian *Sandana the Tempest *Karantun *Gaelzion *Pipspark Thundersnap *Voraazka *Terillod the Devout
Sleepstruck Hatchlings are three faerie dragons found sleeping next to the Unwaking Echo in Verdant Landing in Emerald Dream.
Sleeping Druids are three night elf druids located with Thaalean in a cave in the Slumbersome Shores in the Emerald Dream.
Sleeping Glories are located in the Meandering Rootlands in the Emerald Dream.
The Slavedriver's Cane is a Level 48 quality staff that improves Agility, Stamina and Critical Strike.

A slot is a spot on the interface bar, in a bag, a mail system window, trade window, or the player character's paper doll. Putting an item in a slot on the character's paper doll or the bag slot is known as equipping.
Slow Fall is a level 9 mage utility spell which slows a target's fall speed, allowing leaps off of great heights without taking any fall damage. It can be cosmetically altered via Glyph of Sparkles.

The Slitherblade is a tribe of naga that have landed on the coast of Desolace, and have begun killing anyone who stands in their way. They've been charged with searching the ruins in the area for ancient relics which may show them how to enter the plane of water. Neptulon having discovered what the naga are planning has sent his servants to stop them.
Slick Deviate Leggings is a quest reward from Deviate Hides (Classic).
__NOTOC__ Slimy Murloc Scales drop from murlocs between levels 15-25.
Slimy Scaled Gauntlets is mail hand armor appreciated by Shamans.
Slime-Coated Leggings drops off Viscidus in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj.
Sludge Monstrosities are sludge beast creeps that can be encountered in the Dungeon, Underground and Felwood tilesets.
Slicky Gastronome was a gnome quest giver located in the Military Ward in Ironforge.

The Slithering Scar is a medium sized silithid hive that takes up most of the southern Un'Goro Crater. This hive is home to the Gorishi sect, where they're currently raising a colossus that, when fully grown, will be released into Un'Goro. This hive once had a queen, that was summoned by messing with the Gorishi Silithid Crystal within the hive.

The Sludge Fen (or the Sludge Fens) is an oil field found on the northeast corner of the Northern Barrens. Occupied by the Venture Company for their oil refining projects, the fen is one of the oil platforms that can be visited in-game. This is a dangerous area to adventure in, as the cowardly Venture Co. employees will rush for help if they are attacked. Sludge Fen is led by Tinkerer Sniggles, Foreman Grills and Engineer Whirleygig. During the Legion Invasions, the area was taken over by Oilrig Bombers, Oilrig Snipers and Oil Rig Engineers. Whether the goblins belonged to the Venture Company, Steamwheedle Cartel or the Bilgewater Cartel is not clear. However, the Shortfuse Special bombs loc
Sleight of Hand is a tier 2 talent in the Subtlety rogue tree. Maxing it requires a total of 7 points in Subtlety.

Sludge Anomaly is a rare mob sludge beast ooze found in the sludge of the Sludge Fen in the Barrens. It is on a 4-6 hour respawn timer. Unlike most rare mobs, the Sludge Beast is known to drop 2-3 random green items per kill.

Slidore's Gryphon is a gryphon found in Alterac Valley. If successfully summoned by its master, Wing Commander Slidore, it hovers over Frostwolf Graveyard and bombards members of the Horde from above. The summoning quest is Call of Air - Slidore's Fleet.
Slimeshell Makrura can be found in and at Merchant Coast near Ratchet in the Barrens.

Slither Rock is a small cave found in the far northeastern corner of the Burning Steppes. It used to be inhabited by a sole creature - the black dragonspawn Cyrus Therepentous. Hidden beyond the Terror Wing Path, Cyrus would nevertheless aid adventurers in vanquishing a common foe, albeit not without an ample supply of rude and derisive comments. Now Acride resides in the cave.
__NOTOC__ Sleyin is a blood elf weapon vendor located at Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods.
Slimescale Bracers are a pair of Level 50 quality Mail Bracers that improves Intellect, Stamina and Critical Strike.
Slippers of the Seacaller are epic cloth boots for DPS casters.
.]] Slow is a mage class talent. It reduces the movement speed of a target for 15 seconds.
Slightly Rusted Bracers are a quest reward Replenishing the Healing Crystals.

Slime-Covered Corpse can be found in Hellfire Peninsula. His name is Arelion, who was studying the Pools of Aggonar, when he was overwhelmed by the oozes that inhabit the pools.
Slitherblade Sea Witches are naga found in northwestern Desolace.
The Slightly Creased Note was provided as an objective for Dearest Elenia, (Orgrimmar).
Slightly Worn Bracer is a quest reward from Nightstalker Clean Up, Isle 2...
Slimy Bags drop from various oozes in Dustwallow Marsh and Hinterlands.
Slightly Used Ranger's Blade is a quest reward for The Ring of Mmmrrrggglll.
Slitherblade Oracles are naga found at the Slitherblade Shore in the Desolace.

{{tooltip-wc3 |mode={} |arg={} |name=Slippers of Agility +3 |icon=BTNSlippersOfAgility |desc=Increases the Agility of the Hero by 3 when worn. |sell=50 }} Increases the Agility of the Hero by 3 when worn.
Slidore's Beacon is provided by Wing Commander Slidore in Alterac Valley. It can be placed in the Field of Strife.

Slink Strong is the owner of Slink Strong's Goblin Circus. His circus is famous for its goblin acrobats who know the tricks of goblin tumbling. He bases his "line of death" stunt on a reliable, Ratchet-designed phlogistic unicycle and 10 pulley guns firing a spider silk line.
Sludge is a bog beast summoned by Lord Malathrom in Duskwood.
Sloth is a bog beast summoned by Lord Malathrom in Duskwood.
Slinkin the Demo-gnome was a gnome who was killed in the mines under Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight. He bears a note about how he came about his end.
Slumber Sand is found at the Altar of Storms in the Burning Steppes.
Slimming Ankle Bracelet can be found in a Patroller's Pack which is awarded for completing the Troll Patrol daily quest in Zul'Drak.

__NOTOC__ :What better way to give thanks for a bountiful harvest than with this showpiece of Pilgrim's Bounty? This tender and flavorful bird will satisfy everyone in your party, but don't be surprised if it also lures a few strangers who are eager for a serving!World of Warcraft: The Official Cookbook Slow-Roasted Turkey is a Pilgrim's Bounty food. The creation of one of these is part of the objective of the achievement Now We're Cookin'.
__NOTOC__ Slippery Eel is fished in the pools inside the main entrance to the Violet Hold in Dalaran.
Slither is found in Zul'Aman as one of the eight possible adds for Hex Lord Malacrass.
Slime Samples drop from Entropic Oozes, found near the caves at Vordrassil's Heart, Vordrassil's Tears, and Vordrassil's Limb in Grizzly Hills.
Sliver is the ravager pet of the satyr hunter Garaxxas who serves Kael'thas in the Magisters' Terrace.

The Slimeshell is a tribe of makrura found at the Merchant Coast near Ratchet in the Northern Barrens. Since they are nameless, it is presumed the makrura in Bladefist Bay, Deadeye Shore, Scuttle Coast and Darkspear Strand in Durotar also belong to the same group.
Slitherblade Trident is given by Valishj to complete the quest Wetter Than Wet.
Slitherblade Staff is given to you by Valishj in Slitherblade Shore in Desolace, as part of the quest Deep Impact.
__NOTOC__ Slickskin Eels are eels that swims in the vicinity of Gorrok's Lament and among the Kelp'thar Forest.
Slippers of High Honor are a quest reward from Rite of Honor.

The Slick is a beach of Bilgewater Port in Kezan. It is north of KTC Headquarters and Kaja'mine. It is highly polluted because of the several oil platforms there, and yet still relaxed upon by goblins. Strand Crabs and Kezan Citizens can be found along its length. Julia Scrabblewrench and her cats can also be found here.

The Sludge Fields is a Forsaken fortification built over the town of Hillsbrad Fields. It is an internment camp or prison where the captured humans of Lordaeron are sent for labor to work on the Lordaeron's largest sludge and mushroom plantation. It comprises of guard towers and searchlights, and there are also plague tanks present as well. Warden Stillwater resides and oversees here.
Slider Cider-Marinated Cutlets is provided by Colonel Troteman and Eitrigg for A Delivery for Thorg'izog.
Slippers of the Twilight Prophet drop from High Priestess Azil in Stonecore.
The Slow Blade is a weapon shop found in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. The shop is run by Kareth.
Slippers of the Lonely Road is a quest reward from Rough Roads.

Slithering Cove is a subzone of the Twilight Highlands, located north of Dragonmaw Port at . Naga (of Blackscale) warriors (Blackscale Raider) and sorcerers (Blackscale Mistress) ceaselessly erupt from the water to fight with Dragonmaw soldiers on the beach.
Slink Strong's Goblin Circus was a goblin circus known for its goblin acrobats who know the tricks of goblin tumbling. It is apparently owned by Slink Strong.
Sludgeguard Tower is a Forsaken guard tower of Hillsbrad Foothills located between the Sludge Fields and Dalaran Crater, adjacent the Brazie Farmstead.

Sludge Guards are the guard NPCs found in the Sludge Fields of Hillsbrad Foothills, wearing protective gear in order to prevent them from becoming infected while combating the mindless zombies there. A number of them have been turned into s in the course of their duties. They appear to be loyal to the treacherous and will turn hostile when the player confronts him at the behest of . During the Legion invasions, they could be found cornered by demons or controlled by Subjugator Val'rek. Saving them would improve the score of defense against the Legion.
__NOTOC__ Slitherfin Eels are eels found in Kelp'thar Forest.

Slingtail Pits is a subzone of Jade Forest. Slingtail hozen of the Forest Hozen have taken prisoners from Pearlfin Village and the Wreck of the Vanguard here. It is led by Chief Gukgut, who has a pet tiger named Kung Din. Jinyu and the Alliance are later able to retake the Pits from the hozen. Slingtail Pits then are used as a training place for the Jinyu. Slingtail Pits pit.jpg|The pit

Slicky Stream is a small river fed by the Lake Kittitata that separates the Tigers' Wood and Grookin Hill in west-central Jade Forest. The stream, which is patrolled by the jinyu, runs through the forest until hitting Pearl Lake, however, the actual subzone ends at Fox Grove. The jinyu also have their rafts on the banks. Shortly before the battle at Serpent's Heart, the jinyu were seemingly gone from the area, and it was patrolled by Grookin Furrymasters and Grookin Grenadiers.
Slovan is a saurok located at Winds' Edge in Krasarang Wilds.
Slimy Inkstain is a grummle located in the Grummle Bazaar in Kun-Lai Summit.

Slingtail Treeleapers are Slingtail hozen responsible with patrolling the Slingtail Pits in the Jade Forest and supervising the Jinyu and Alliance Prisoners. They have the Bamboo Key which is required for Freeing Our Brothers and also required to be slain in The Path of War for an easy escape.

Slingtail Fishrippers are Slingtail hozen found in the Slingtail Pits in the Jade Forest. They are fighting the Pearlfin Poolwatchers in an attempt to raid the Pearlfin Village. They need to be cleared in Jailbreak so that Bold Karasshi can return successfully to the village with Admiral Taylor.
Slingtail Recruists are hozen located in Slingtail Pits in the Jade Forest.
__NOTOC__ Slingtail Ambushers are hozen located in the Bamboo Wilds in the Jade Forest.
Slickback Remoras are giant remora swimming on Beth'mora Ridge in Shimmering Expanse.
